adds.rationale: Uranium spot prices resumed climbing in early 2023 and Cameco locked in a major long-term supply contract with Ukraine's Energoatom, evidence the nuclear buildup wave is broadening upstream into mining, not just SMR reactor design and LEU enrichment.

news_evidence.summary: Cameco reached agreement on commercial terms for a major UF6 supply contract with Ukraine's Energoatom covering nuclear fuel needs through 2035 (~25.7M kgU); contract finalization expected in Q1 2023

Uranium price expected to rise in 2023 on nuclear power revival; spot uranium climbed from $48.66 to over $50/lb in a two-week span as several developed countries announced life extensions and new construction for nuclear plants

rationale_overall: The watchlist's core shape holds: AI (AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) stays fully populated on continued concrete milestones (Microsoft's $10B OpenAI investment Jan 23, Google's Bard unveil Feb 6-8, Nvidia's Hopper/H100 ramp), rockets/spacecraft (RKLB, PL) is reinforced by Rocket Lab's first US-soil launch and record Q4 revenue growth plus Planet Labs' record FY23 revenue, and defense (LMT, ITA) is underpinned by the record $842B FY24 Pentagon budget request. Quantum (IONQ), demographics/healthcare (ISRG), tanker/commodities (STNG) and robotics (BOTZ) show no thesis breach and are kept. The one net add, CCJ, extends the nuclear sub-theme (already SMR/LEU) upstream into uranium mining just as spot uranium prices resumed climbing and Cameco locked in a decade-plus Ukraine supply contract. Net effect: watchlist grows from 15 to 16 (at the cap), nuclear bucket goes from 2 to 3 tickers (still under the 4-ticker diversity limit), no other bucket is touched.
